description: A PHP class implementing a filesystem loader for Twig templates, handling template path management, cache, and template retrieval logic.

classes.name: FilesystemLoader
classes.description: Implements template loading from the filesystem, managing paths, cache, and template parsing for Twig.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with paths and an optional root path.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of template paths for a specified namespace.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets multiple paths for a given namespace.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path to the namespace, throwing an error if the directory does not exist.

methods.name: prependPath
methods.description: Prepends a new path to the namespace's path list, throwing an error if the directory does not exist.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source content of a template by name.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a template, relative to the root path.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks whether the template has been modified since a given timestamp.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Searches for a template file in registered paths, returning its path or throwing an error.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes template names to a consistent format.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses a template name into namespace and filename.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates that a template name lacks null bytes and attempts to access outside allowed directories.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute.
